text: {"misconceptions":[{"id":"loop.off-by-one-index","confidence":0.96,"reason":"The loop iterates total from 1 to n inclusive, but the ways list is sized n, so ways[total] (and the final return ways[n]) accesses an index beyond the list bounds."}],"summary":"An off‑by‑one error causes the algorithm to read/write past the end of the ways array."}

misconceptions.reason: The loop iterates total from 1 to n inclusive, but the ways list is sized n, so ways[total] (and the final return ways[n]) accesses an index beyond the list bounds.

data.summary: An off‑by‑one error causes the algorithm to read/write past the end of the ways array.
